metadata.description: The application category of orderable composition: a service a consumer uses, assembled from compute, data and network parts that are provisioned and maintained together. Yields a maintained thing — it keeps running and reconciles — which is what separates this category from a terminal-yield one whose outcome is a run that completes.

zone.description: The SovereigntyZone this composition must be placed within — a reference to a `Knowledge/SovereigntyZone` record, which declares what the coined zone name means in ISO 3166 terms so the residency-subsumption match is computable rather than assumed. Never a bare coined string: a name without a declared meaning gives an auditor no answer.

classification.description: The data-classification floor the placement must satisfy. The vocabulary is a free string today and should be a governed one — the same hole `zone` had before its class existed, tracked at #472 — so a peer reading `restricted` learns only the word.

cohesion.description: same_zone = every constituent must land in ONE zone satisfying the floor, a JOINT constraint over the placement set. per_constituent = each satisfies the floor independently. No default: which one applies is the composition author's decision and UDLM ships no defaults (NDF-001).

sovereignty_floor.description: The sovereignty requirement this composition must hold, carried as immutable data and communicated to whoever decides admission (ADR-057 — UDLM codifies, does not vet). Realized onto each constituent's `sovereignty` block at placement. A joint constraint is evaluable only once every placement is known, which is why placement sits inside the convergence loop rather than after it: a cohesion failure must RE-PLACE, and that is another iteration, not a post-placement correction.

groupings.description: Additional NON-isolating groupings the realized constituents join — cost center, project, business unit. References Grouping records under advisory enforcement, where a member may belong to many. Deliberately NOT the System's own grouping, which derives from the composite's uuid and is never stored (DRV-001), and deliberately NOT a tenant: a tenant boundary is an isolation border carried on the realized entity's `tenant_uuid`, never chosen by a Template.

high_availability.description: Whether this application is composed to survive the loss of a single fault domain — a property of the WHOLE, not of any one part, which is exactly why it had no home before. A constituent may be individually redundant while the application still fails as a unit, so this is a statement about the composition rather than a rollup of its parts. It constrains placement and the shape of the constituents a provider projection may offer; it never asserts that the requirement was met, which is realized state.

endpoint.description: Where the realized application is reached — the address a consumer or a downstream binding uses. Published by the composition rather than by any constituent: which part terminates traffic is an internal arrangement the consumer must not have to know, and it may change between provider projections of the same application without the endpoint changing.

context.purpose: Let a consumer order an application as ONE thing — the whole shape, wired, placed and reconciled together — instead of ordering the parts and re-deriving how they connect every time.
context.plain_description: A ready-made application shape. Somebody who knows how the pieces fit wrote it down once; you order it, choose the few things that are yours to choose, and get a running application.
use_when: An application is ordered repeatedly and its shape should not be re-derived per order
The parts must be placed, reconciled and decommissioned as a unit rather than individually
A sovereignty or grouping requirement applies to the WHOLE rather than to each part
not_for: A single resource with no parts — order the resource class directly
Work whose outcome is a run that completes rather than a thing that keeps running; that is a terminal-yield category, which must declare a bounded execution time and this one cannot
Recording a composition nobody is offering — an ingested diagram or a consumer's own bundle is a composition record, which never mints a class into the shared vocabulary
works_with: the provider tier beneath this class, which carries the actual constituents and the `supports` ranges a consumer picks from
a realized System, whose `tenant_uuid`, sovereignty and edges are written at placement
